description: Move guaranteed Peerless from Erza2624 to Chunhyang3040; set Erza Paladin and Chunhyang Berserker once per instance. Egeya and other traits preserved. One numeric instance revision permits later earned/manual changes.

edits.old:
! JO9 MOD START ERZA_BRANCH_IMAGES_TRAITS_20261101
   if dynslave_type = 2624: dynslave['jo9_peerless'] = 1
! JO9 MOD END ERZA_BRANCH_IMAGES_TRAITS_20261101
edits.new:
! JO9 MOD START UNIQUE_CHARACTER_TRAITS_20261112
   ! One-time preset revision clears the former Erza guarantee without blocking later earned traits.
   if dynslave_type = 2624 and dynslave['jo9_erza_chun_preset_rev'] < 1:
    dynslave['jo9_peerless'] = 0
    dynslave['jo9_combat_trait'] = 2
    dynslave['jo9_erza_chun_preset_rev'] = 1
   elseif dynslave_type = 3040 and dynslave['jo9_erza_chun_preset_rev'] < 1:
    dynslave['jo9_combat_trait'] = 1
    dynslave['jo9_erza_chun_preset_rev'] = 1
   end
   if dynslave_type = 3040: dynslave['jo9_peerless'] = 1
! JO9 MOD END UNIQUE_CHARACTER_TRAITS_20261112
